description: This PHP file defines an abstract class 'AbstractComposite' for creating composite validation rules within a human resource management system. It allows combining multiple rules into a single composite rule that can be validated as a unit.

classes.name: AbstractComposite
classes.description: An abstract class for composite validation rules that aggregates multiple Rule instances and applies them collectively.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts multiple Rule objects and stores them.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input by instantiating each rule with its constructor parameters and applying the composite rule's validation logic.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the class name of the specific composite rule.
